purpose: Multi-ROI direct-build/drop probe: process several local motion component ROIs and then drop refreshed fragments that still have no stereo evidence.
expected_effect: Test whether multi-ROI coverage is enough to make the direct-build/drop route safe on real hand occlusion.
Keep ROI locality while attempting to pass the G2 direct-build specialty gate.
Expose whether runtime fragment drops remain a G3 risk after multi-ROI refresh.
risk: Dropping stereo-failed fragments can still remove valid image-only contours.
More ROI components may increase sync refresh cost.
This remains probe-only unless G3 is pass and visual review confirms no target loss.
